This comes from a PVE player perspective so you already know where I'm going.  I enjoyed the game, and early on you can run into a player and not have to defend yourself.  I don't mind interacting with others, hell even had some good gunfights against larger ARC's.  It was a blast, but since about lvl 18, I'm like 23 now, anytime I'm in a duo with another player, PVP every single match.   In regards to the recent algorithm we only return fire, never initiate PVP.  Been that way since we started a few weeks ago.

I don't mind the pvp so much when solo, I can get through 3 or 4 runs and actually make some progress.  Try to play with my homie, even just a duo, and you're lucky to make it out of a single round.  I got my $30 out of it, but if you're a PVE player and especially a PVE player that wants to game with your homies.  Just save yourself the frustration, I wanted to enjoy this game.  I tried to adapt my play to the environment, creeping slowly, quietly.  No, this game does not respect your time.

I really like this game, but after 290 hrs. I am so tired of looting for 20 minutes, only to be shot in the back by a grieffer or rat. If something is not done to protect my loot or guns, I am done. 
Why should a robber be rewarded, and I get nothing? Every death I experienced was cowardly, never faced in front, but attacked from behind with no chance to defend myself.
I envision raiders fighting arc as a team, not each other.
There are 2 videos in the game store page, it shows raiders working together to defeat Arc, nowhere did I see raider vs raider shootouts.
